Name: Stardew Valley - Roguelike
Author: TheTrain2000
Description:
[size=5]Welcome to The Abyss![/size]

[url=https://roguelike.tyler.solutions/#]Leaderboard Link[/url] 

[color=#1e84cc][quote]This mod [b]HIDES[/b] your existing save files! Your save files will reappear upon uninstallation of this mod. Your save files are untouched.[/quote][/color]

With this mod we bring a new experience to Stardew Valley. Explore and fight your way through an infinitely deep mine. Are you able to reach the bottom? Can you reach the bottom faster than everyone else? Find out with the online leaderboard! After each run through, you can upload your stats online to compare with the world.

For the optimal experience, use this mod with no other mods installed. For competitive purposes, runs cannot be uploaded online if other mods are detected.

[b]Features[/b]

[list]
[*][size=2]10 unique boss fights[/size]
[*][size=2]Custom floor layouts[/size]
[*][size=2]Floors with unique challenges[/size]
[*][size=2]Custom in-game perks and curses[/size]
[*][size=2]Online leaderboard system[/size]
[*][size=2]Difficulty scaling and hard mode[/size]
[*][size=2]Multiplayer support[/size]
[/list]
